My Liege;

I have learned that "someone" has hired the Red Claw to assassinate the Lord Paladine. Considering that you and him used to be friends, and knowing that you did
not hire the Red Claw (or anyone) to do such a deed, or even approve of this, I took it upon myself to alert you of this unexpected turn of events.

After scrupulous investigations on my part, I have come to the conclusion that 1) an Overlord paid the Red Claw to assassinate the Lord Paladine (something the guild
has aptly named "Operation: Beheading"), and 2) this Overlord (whose name I have yet to find out) is posing as a High Councilor. Although I do not think that our own "insider" contact and the Overlord impostor are one and the same, I did find out that the Red Claw is keeping a mysterious "guest" in one of their cells. Hence, I must approach our "contact" with caution from now on, until such a time that I can establish with certainty that he is not an Overlord.

As for the Red Claw's "Operation: Beheading", I shall await your instructions on whether I should intervene or not in its successful outcome ... or failure. I must warn you that the guild has already managed to infiltrate the Lord Paladine's castle, and that it stands poised to do the deed.

Always yours to serve;

The Raven
Royal Master Spy

Dear and respected Lord Solomon Hardin,

As you know or may have heard, I have returned upon my father's death. Although it shames me to have learned of his involvement with those malevolent beings known as
Overlords and their evil conspiracies, the responsabilities of managing my late father's estates and companies are now mine to bear. Of course, I was made aware upon my return of all these long business negociations between you and my father concerning the acquisition of your company by my father's. That is why I wish to continue in his name these negociations, in hoping that our partnership will finally take shape for our mutual interests. It is my hope that you feel the same; thus, I am at your disposition should you wish to resume the negociations, at your earliest convenience.

Yours sincerely,

Shalla Thrall
Written on this day of Setting, 9th day of the Month of Sunning, Year of the Great War {1166 R.R.}

To His Dread and Invincible Majesty, the Sublime Warlord and King of Sharranth; To Her Excellency, the Herzog of the Heartlands; And to His Excellency, General Haxor Tharn
---------------------------------------------

Our ally in Tanirith has been quite successful at turning the High Council into a confused, hesitant, and ineffectual ruling body. Even the Lord Paladine, the councilor Jarad Noll, and High Commander Fireblade are hard pressed and at a loss as to correct this current state of affairs.

I can therefore assure you that the campaign of the Heartlands has nothing to fear from Tanirith, and that Wailsrond stands effectively alone against us.

Be aware, however, that the Lord Paladine is seeking the help of adventurers, most likely those who defeated the Overlords the last time (which are known as the "Heroes of the Sword Lands"). If they have left the region, then the Lord Paladine will be willing to hire the help of any adventuring party. At least, that is what our ally reported, and this has been confirmed by my agents. In fact, the Lord Paladine intends to give command of a warband to such adventurers, thus circumventing the current impasse at the High Council concerning sending troops to help the Wailsrondese.

However, whether such measures prove fruitful to Tanirith and Wailsrond will be up to our forces already established and entrenched in the Heartlands.

Written on this day of Endweek, 11th day of the month of Harvest, Year of the Great War {1166 R.R. (Realmz Reckoning)}

 The Raven
Royal Spy of His Dread and Invincible Majesty, the Sublime Warlord and King of Sharranth

To my Esteemed and Valued Commander of Arms, General Haxor Tharn;

I have read your last letter and pondered the valid points you have put forth in it. However, I must agree with our Herzog of the Heartlands that it would be wiser strategically to turn Aranys into the new center of the Heartlands, both military and
commercially. Remember that the ultimate prize of the present campaign is to acquire Tanirith. Hence, occupying Wailsrond would be costly in men and weapons, all the while weakening our hold on Sparklestone (and its riches) and leaving us on the defensive from attacks by Tanirith.

So, it is my hope that you now see the wisdom in leveling Wailsrond instead of occupying it. In war and conquest, one must sacrifice his best piece at one time or another, if one is to win the contest. That is how I view Wailsrond: a strategic piece that is needed to be sacrificed if we are to succeed with our final push to Tanirith.

So I urge you, as your Liege and long-time friend, to do as I asked of you, and level that city once and for all. Of course, I expect you to ransack it in order to obtain as much riches as you can, in order to provide us with more monies to finance our campaign.

I wish you success and victory;

Written on this day of Rising, 27th of the month of Sunning, Year of the Great War
{1166 R.R. (Realmz Reckoning)}

Anthraxus Storm
Dread and Invincible Majesty, WarLord and Sublime King of Sharranth.

To the Lord Paladine, The High Council, And the People of Tanirith
---------------------------------------------

It was with much rejoicing that we heard news of the end of the siege of Wailsrond, and her victory over her invaders. Although not our allies, we have numerous treaties of friendship and trade with the Wailsrondese, a proud, hard-working, honest and peaceful people whom we respect and care for. However, it was with utter disbelief, bewilderment, and anger that we learned that Tanirith did nothing to help her ally and friend, despite being bound by a treaty of alliance to do so.

In this respect, we consider that Tanirith bears great shame for failing to send troops to the aid of Wailsrond. And this shame does not only befall upon the Lord Paladine and the High Council, but upon the citizens of Tanirith as well.

To this effect, it is our opinion that Tanirith is untrustworthy of being an ally and, sadly, we consider our alliance treaty with Tanirith null and void. However, for the sake of continued peaceful relations and commerce between our cities, we have not revoked our non-agression and trade treaties with Tanirith.

Nonetheless, it is with a heavy heart indeed that we must caution the city of Tanirith, and its shameful leaders, that Lantharond will henceforth remain ever watchful, judging and mistrustful of Tanirith's actions, whether they be political, military or commercial in nature.

Written on this day of Resting, 6th day of the month of Coldmantle, Year of the Great War {1166 R.R. (Realmz Reckoning)}

 Erion Dragonshield Royal Regent of Their Sublime Excellencies, Queen Aramina Dragonclaw and King Vallar Dragonheart, Scions of Lantharond and Anointed Keepers of the Dragonthrone

To the Lord Paladine, The High Council, And the People of Tanirith
-----------------------------------------

It was with much distress and sadness that we heard news of the fall of Wailsrond. Although not our allies, we had numerous treaties of friendship and trade with the Wailsrondese, a proud, hard-working, honest and peaceful people whom we always respected and cared for. Therefore, it was with utter disbelief, bewilderment, and anger that we learned that Tanirith did nothing to help her ally and friend, despite being bound by a treaty of alliance to do so.

In this respect, we consider that Tanirith bears the shame of Wailsrond's fall and destruction, almost as if Tanirith had commited such atrocity herself. And this shame does not only befall upon the Lord Paladine and the High Council, but upon the citizens of Tanirith as well.

To this effect, it is our opinion that Tanirith is untrustworthy of being an ally and, sadly, we consider our alliance treaty with Tanirith null and void. However, for the sake of continued peaceful relations and commerce between our cities, we have not revoked our non-agression and trade treaties with Tanirith.

Nonetheless, it is with a heavy heart indeed that we must caution the city of Tanirith, and its shameful leaders, that Lantharond will henceforth remain ever watchful, judging and mistrustful of Tanirith's actions, whether they be political, military or commercial in nature.

Written on this day of Resting, 6th day of the month of Coldmantle, Year of the Great War {1166 R.R. (Realmz Reckoning)}

 Erion Dragonshield
Royal Regent of Their Sublime Excellencies, Queen Aramina Dragonclaw and King Vallar Dragonheart, Scions of Lantharond and Anointed Keepers of the Dragonthrone

Priority Assignment --- To all Guildmembers ---

As you know from reading the attached letter from the Supreme Warlock of Sharranth, our associates require that a certain party of adventurers be put out of their way.

Although the promised reward amounts to twenty thousand gold pieces, I have been assured by our associates that double the amount will be paid to our Guild treasury if any one of our Guildmembers performs the deed.

Therefore, I decree that the completion of this assignment be ranked as the highest priority for all Guildmembers, superceding the priority of any other assignments (of course, with the exception of "Operation: Beheading" already underway).

Failure to enact this directive on the part of any Guildmember will result in his (or her) immediate final, irrevocable and fatal termination of membership in the Red Claw.

Written on this day of Dawning, 18th of the month of Fallfest, Year of the Great War {1166 R.R. (Realmz Reckoning)}

The Shadowsilk
Grand Dagger of the Red Claw - Cabal of Tanirith

Wanted: Dead for substantial bounty

It is our wish that those individuals of whom the description has been given out to you be found and killed.

Use any means necessary as long as their heads be in recognizable condition, tokens which you must bring as proof of your deed and the handing of the promised reward of twenty thousand gold pieces in gems.

Remember that no word of our offer must be divulged, nor surrendering this letter to lawful authorities outside of Sharranth; otherwise, rest assured that you will be found in order to meet the fate of the aforementioned quarries.

Furthermore, make sure to destroy the descriptive drawings of your querries after memorizing well their features. This letter you must keep in order to present it (along with the heads of your querries) upon receiving the pledged reward.

In case of dire need, you may seek the advice of the Herzog of the Heartlands in Aranys. Her Excellency the Herzog is fully briefed and is playing a coordinating role on this matter, by the Writ of his Dread and Invincible Majesty, the Sublime King of Sharranth.

Written on this day of Midweek, 13th of the month of Harvest, Year of the Great War {1166 R.R. (Realmz Reckoning)}

Ertham Zoh
Supreme Warlock of His Dread and Invincible Majesty, the WarLord and
Sublime King of Sharranth.
